description: This file defines the TimezonesAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for listing timezone data, including optional filtering by timezone name, formatted with labels and offsets.

classes.name: TimezonesAPI
classes.description: API endpoint for retrieving a list of timezones, with optional filtering by timezone name. Implements methods for data retrieval and validation, inheriting from Endpoint and implementing CollectionEndpoint interface.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all timezones, with optional filtering by timezone name. Returns a sorted collection of timezone data including name, label (offset label), and offset.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, specifically validating the optional 'timezoneName' query parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as creating new timezone entries is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as create operation is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as delete operation is not supported.
